Opens the Visor PS menu over any app

Lets the PS button on a game controller open Visor\'s quick menu over other apps. It reads key presses only to spot the PS button, and while the menu is open the menu keys. It notes which app is in front only to skip apps you set to keep the PS button. It does not read screen content, except for one job you start yourself: the task manager\'s experimental Force stop, which clicks the buttons on an app\'s App Info page. It stores nothing about the apps you use.
